title: Site spec
description: Single source of truth for a site rendered by engine.js. Every block has a "type" that maps to one builder in BLOCK_RENDERERS. Edit this file, not the engine. Validated at ship time by launch-check.js; this schema gives editing-time validation + autocomplete in the IDE.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file (enables IDE validation). Keep as ./site-spec.schema.json.

brand.description: Brand / site name. Shown as the header text unless brandImage is set; always used for the footer copyright and as the logo's alt text.

brandImage.description: Optional logo image path (e.g. assets/logo.png) that replaces the header brand text. Monochrome black-on-transparent PNGs are auto-inverted in dark theme. brand stays required as alt text / copyright.

sections.description: Top-level sections. Each becomes a nav tab + a tabpanel of blocks.

note.description: Footer note. Trusted inline HTML allowed (authored content only).

backgrounds.description: Background image paths; the engine crossfades through them.

business.description: Single source of truth for contact + legal data. Blocks reference it by key (e.g. a links block's "use": ["phone","email"]) instead of restating values.

phone.description: Phone in display form; the engine builds the tel: href.

label.description: One-line address used in static map cards and schema.

mapUrl.description: Public Google Maps link (Open in Maps button).

geo.description: Exact pin coordinates of the business, emitted as GeoCoordinates in the JSON-LD (local-search queries resolve on these). Get them from the resolved Google Maps place URL (!3d = lat, !4d = lng).

priceRange.description: Relative price bracket for the JSON-LD priceRange property, e.g. "€€" or "12–95 €".

areaServed.description: Human-readable service area for the JSON-LD areaServed property, e.g. "Greater Anytown".

mapEmbed.description: Google Maps embed URL for the live iframe.

hours.description: Opening hours by weekday. Values are free-form display strings (e.g. "9:00–17:00", "Closed"). Rendered by the "hours" block, which highlights the current day. Missing days render as a dash.

domain.description: Canonical site URL with trailing slash.

ogImage.description: Social share image path (relative, e.g. assets/og_image.jpg). og:image + twitter:image are only emitted when set.

ogImageWidth.description: Pixel width of ogImage; emitted as og:image:width (needs ogImageHeight too).

ogImageHeight.description: Pixel height of ogImage; emitted as og:image:height (needs ogImageWidth too).

socialColors.description: Per-channel accent colors keyed by social/contact key.

headerLabel.description: Optional label used only for the header brand cluster and mobile drawer; falls back to `label` when omitted. Lets the header button read differently from the same link in contacts.

icon.description: Icon key (must match a key in SOCIAL_ICONS in engine.js).

id.description: Unique section id; used as the anchor (#id) and tab id.

label.description: Nav tab label (defaults to id if omitted).

title.description: Optional heading rendered at the top of the section.

blockText.description: Free/rich text paragraph. Trusted inline HTML allowed (authored content only).

name.description: Optional serif heading above the paragraph (same look as table/faq block names).

format.description: How `text` is interpreted: html = sanitized inline HTML (default), markdown = tiny inline subset (**bold**, *em*, [link](url)), plain = everything escaped.

blockCards.description: Responsive card grid. linked:true + per-item url makes each card a link.

meta.description: Small accent label (shows a go-arrow on linked cards).

url.description: Link target; required if the card should be clickable.

icon.description: Optional monochrome icon shown to the left of the text, vertically centered — a black PNG on a transparent background. Auto-inverted to white in dark theme; one asset works on both themes.

blockLinks.description: Contact/social link rows. Prefer "use" (SSOT refs into business/socials); "items" adds explicit rows after them. At least one of use/items must be non-empty.

layout.description: rows (default) = stacked full-width rows; grid = side-by-side tiles (auto-stacks when narrow).

icon.description: Icon key (must match SOCIAL_ICONS in engine.js).

kind.description: Small muted line above the value ("Telefón", "Web", …). Defaults from the icon key for known icons.

blockMap.description: Map block. mode:"embed" (default) live iframe, or mode:"static" themed address card. url/embed are optional here — when omitted the engine falls back to business.mapUrl / business.mapEmbed (SSOT). launch-check.js flags a map that resolves to nothing.

embed.description: Google Maps embed URL / iframe src (overrides business.mapEmbed).

address.description: Address line for the static card / accessible fallback.

blockSlideshow.description: 1 slide = framed image; 2+ = carousel with prev/next, dots, lightbox.

blockTable.description: Responsive table (price list etc.). Rows are arrays of cells in heading order. By default the last column is accent-styled as a price/value; set accentValue: false for prose tables (conditions, company data).

accentValue.description: false = no accent price styling on the last column (use for prose tables).

offerCatalog.description: true = this table is a price list exported into the JSON-LD as a schema.org OfferCatalog (first cell = service name, last cell = price, middle cells = description). Not rendered by the engine — consumed by business-jsonld.mjs only. Leave off prose tables.

collapsible.description: true = the table renders collapsed behind its name as an accordion toggle (same pattern as faq); the blurb collapses with it. Requires `name` — without one the flag is ignored and the table renders expanded. Presentation only: JSON-LD/llms.txt exports are unaffected.

blockFaq.description: Accordion of question/answer pairs. q is plain text; a allows trusted inline HTML (authored content only).

blockGallery.description: Paged responsive image grid sharing the slideshow lightbox. Tiles are image-only; per-image title/caption are NOT shown as visible captions — they feed alt text and the lightbox caption only.

columns.description: Optional column count (2–4) — the engine and CSS only honor these values.

perPage.description: Tiles shown per page before paging. Defaults to 12.

blockPhoto.description: Single image; normalizes to a one-image gallery.

blockHours.description: Opening-hours table. Carries no hours data itself — reads SITE.business.hours (single source of truth) and highlights the current day.

blockReview.description: Leave-a-review CTA block. Renders outbound buttons to external review pages (Google, Facebook, …). No backend — it does not collect or store reviews.

url.description: External review page. Should be an http(s) URL.

platform.description: Optional brand icon/tint. Omit or use an unlisted value for a generic star.

blockVideo.description: YouTube embed via the privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie.com player (no cookies until play). Give ONE source: `url` pins a specific video; `playlist` auto-plays the playlist's newest entry — point it at the channel's UULF… long-form uploads playlist (channel id with UC→UULF) for an always-current 'latest episode'. If both are set the engine uses `url`.

url.description: Pinned video: YouTube URL in any share form (watch?v=, youtu.be/, shorts/, live/, embed/). launch-check fails a URL the engine can't extract an id from.

playlist.description: Auto-newest: a playlist id (PL…/UU…/UULF…) or any URL with ?list=. UU… = all uploads incl. Shorts; UULF… = long-form only (usually what you want for episodes).

title.description: Accessible iframe title; falls back to `name`, then a generic label.

imageItem.description: An image with optional title/caption/text. Only src is required.

thumb.description: Optional smaller rendition for gallery grid tiles; the lightbox always opens the full src.
